unlisted_practices: Supervisor agent validates Evaluator agent reports before they reach the Planner agent
Learner agent synthesizes optimization history into prompt addendums to reduce iterations
Measurement-based patient-specific quality assurance of autonomous radiotherapy plans

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based multi-agent framework (PlanningCopilot) for autonomous radiotherapy treatment planning on retrospective patient datasets. Although it compares plans with and without a 'Learner' agent module, this represents internal system/architecture design rather than an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
